2607.09399.title: Fully Trainable Deep Differentiable Logic Gate Networks and Lookup Table Networks
2607.09399.paper_summary: We introduce a novel method for both partial and full optimization of the connections in deep differentiable logic gate networks (LGNs) and lookup table networks (LUTNs). Our training method utilizes a probability distribution over a set of connections per gate/lookup table (LUT) input pin, selecting the connection with highest merit, all whilst the optimal gate types or LUT-entries are learned in parallel. We show that the connection-optimized LGNs outperform standard fixed-connection LGNs on the Yin-Yang, MNIST Handwritten Digits and Fashion-MNIST benchmarks, while requiring only a fraction of the number of logic gates. We achieve 98.92% on the MNIST dataset with two layers of 8000 gates. With only one layer of 8000 gates, we obtain 98.45%, showing that our method requires almost 50 times fewer gates compared to fixed-connection LGNs. Training stability up to ten layers has been ensured by employing a high learning rate, straight-through estimators and trimming constant-output gate types. Additionally, we present a LUT neuron description that enables stable training with backpropagation, tested up to 6-layer deep networks. The model requires four times fewer trainable parameters and still achieves a higher accuracy compared to the fixed-connection LGN training algorithm. Our connection-training algorithm also works well for the LUTNs, achieving an accuracy of 98.88% for two layers of 2000 6-input LUTs.
2607.09399.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了一種新穎的方法，用於深度可微邏輯閘網絡（LGNs）和查找表網絡（LUTNs）中的連接的部分和完全優化。<lb/>我們的訓練方法利用每個閘/查找表（LUT）輸入針腳的一組連接上的概率分佈，選擇具有最高優勢的連接，同時學習最佳的閘類型或LUT條目。<lb/>我們顯示，連接優化的LGNs在Yin-Yang、MNIST手寫數字和Fashion-MNIST基準測試中超越了標準固定連接的LGNs，並且僅需使用少量的邏輯閘。<lb/>在擁有兩層8000個閘的情況下，我們在MNIST數據集上達到了98.92%。<lb/>僅使用一層8000個閘，我們獲得了98.45%的準確率，顯示我們的方法相比固定連接的LGNs需要幾乎少50倍的閘。<lb/>通過使用高學習率、直通估計器和修剪常數輸出閘類型，確保了訓練的穩定性，最多可達十層。<lb/>此外，我們提出了一種LUT神經元描述，能夠在反向傳播中實現穩定訓練，並在最多6層深的網絡中進行測試。<lb/>該模型需要的可訓練參數比固定連接的LGN訓練算法少四倍，並且仍然達到了更高的準確率。<lb/>我們的連接訓練算法對LUTNs也同樣有效，對於兩層2000個6輸入LUTs達到了98.88%的準確率。
